title: Each person answers an internal form once
description: An internal form now takes one answer from each person, including anonymous forms. If you open a form you have already answered, it says so instead of showing the questions.
items: An anonymous answer still carries no name, and nobody can see who wrote what. A separate note of who has answered is what stops a second answer, and the form now says so
An answer cannot be changed or sent again, so check it before sending
To run a survey again, build a new form
Anonymous answers given before this change cannot be matched to anyone, so those people can answer that form one more time
pending: Needs its database update: paste supabase/migrations/20261103100000_p17_11_one_answer_per_person.sql into the Supabase SQL editor. Until then people can still answer more than once.
